reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so the single-serve sachet solves a problem I don't have. The lab report is a real plus, but $29.99 is more than my bottle costs for the same month.
objection: I already have a magnesium I trust and I take it at home. Paying extra for a portable sachet when I only travel twice a month makes no sense, and it is made in China.
would_change_my_mind: A price near what I pay for a bottle (about $18 to $20 a month), or a small travel-size pack of 4 to 6 sachets I could try before committing to 30.
